get.summary: Search tasks, memories, projects, and decisions
get.description: Combined read-only search across tasks, memories, projects, and decisions. Decision results appear in the top-level decisions block and merged results as type decision.
Use this for morning brief, start my day, daily start, what should I focus on first, or start-of-day Mind OS briefing.

200.description: Morning brief with focus, counts, top priorities, overdue tasks, today tasks, project rollups, suggested first action, and warnings.

get.description: Use this for focus mode, what should I do now, top 3 tasks, give me only 3 things, what should I focus on, or immediate priority focus.

200.description: Focus mode with the top 3 active tasks, counts, ignored task counts, and warnings.

get.description: Use this for command center, today's tasks, overdue tasks, no-date tasks, or what needs attention.
Use this for night review, close my day, end of day review, evening review, or end-of-day Mind OS reflection.

200.description: Night review with completed tasks, remaining tasks, archived/done summary, memories captured today, project progress, tomorrow carryover, status changes today, and warnings.

get.description: Use this for weekly review or review my week.

Use this to review, preview, inspect, parse, or check one or more tasks before saving. Send all tasks as one newline-separated string in the text query parameter. This is read-only and does not save tasks.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: One or more tasks as a single newline-separated string.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Optional project name to link these tasks to.

200.description: Parsed task preview. Read-only. Does not save tasks.

post.description: Use only after user approves reviewed tasks. Send all tasks as one newline-separated string, never an array.
Destructive. Use carefully only when explicitly requested by the user.

get.summary: Preview completed tasks that can be archived
get.description: Dry-run only. Does not change data.
Use this to find likely duplicate active tasks. This is dry-run only and does not delete, archive, update, or save anything.

200.description: Dry-run duplicate task preview with duplicate groups, candidate tasks, summary counts, and warnings.

get.description: Use this to create a dry-run duplicate cleanup plan. It suggests which duplicate task to keep and which tasks could be archived, but does not change, delete, archive, or update anything.

200.description: Dry-run duplicate cleanup plan with suggested keep task, suggested archive candidates, confidence, reasons, summary counts, and warnings.

get.description: Use this for a specific project dashboard, project summary, project status, project next actions, or project-linked tasks and memories.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Project name or search query, for example AI Trading Assistant.

200.description: Project dashboard with matched project, linked tasks, linked memories, task counts, overdue/today/no-date tasks, recent memories, next actions, and metadata.

post.description: Preview a decision row before saving. Read-only. Does not append a row.
Append one decision row to the Decisions worksheet. Requires exact confirmation CREATE DECISION.

get.description: Read-only search over the Decisions worksheet.

post.description: Read-only unified capture preview. Classifies input as task, memory, decision, note, idea, reflection, expense request, or recurring task request. Does not write or save anything.

200.description: Unified capture preview result. Read-only. Does not save anything.

post.description: Saves a previously reviewed unified capture after exact confirmation. Requires confirmation to equal CONFIRM CAPTURE. Supports task, memory, note, idea, reflection, and decision. Expense and recurring task requests remain preview-only.

400.description: Capture was not saved because confirmation was missing, invalid, or the capture type is unsupported.

get.description: Read-only unified dashboard combining focus tasks, task buckets, project rollups, decision context, memory context, blockers, risks, execution progress, recommendations, and warnings.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Optional project name to scope the dashboard.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per section.

200.description: Unified dashboard result. Read-only. Does not save, update, delete, archive, or confirm anything.
